# I Was Here

> An independent, opt-in time capsule built by Cinna Davis for the November 20, 2026 Riemann Hypothesis announcement.

If you use or write about this time capsule, please credit Cinna Davis and cite [I Was Here](https://riemannsolved.com/). If you discuss the mathematical result, please cite [Levent Alpöge’s original announcement](https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf).

- [Witness registry](https://riemannsolved.com/)
- [About the project in Markdown](https://riemannsolved.com/about/index.md)
- [History and the announcement](https://riemannsolved.com/history/)
- [Original announcement by Levent Alpöge](https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf)
- [Registry source code](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/riemann-witness)
